evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: This work contributes a realistic task definition, extends current state of the art evaluation frameworks, allows evaluation of systems that predict mappings and RDF data alike, and combines evaluation of both KG construction and downstream usage.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) play an increasingly important role in numerous applications ranging from traditional knowledge representation to serving as memory for LLMs to support downstream tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In this work, we thus focus on the evaluation of KG construction from semi-structured data and present a benchmark and evaluation pipeline for KG construction that combines the quality dimensions (1) syntactic validity, (2) semantic accuracy, (3) consistency, (4) conciseness, (5) completeness, and (6) pragmatic quality measured on a KG's ability to provide answers to competency questions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared to the popularity of construction approaches that focus on textual input data, methods for semi-structured inputs remain underrepresented and as a result, no comprehensive benchmark and evaluation suite exists to judge the quality of mapping predictions and generated KGs.
